observations: Original Sony PlayStation 4 console with a split glossy/matte top cover.
Photo 0 shows a camouflage pattern DualShock 4 controller.
Photo 1 shows a standard black DualShock 4 controller.
The console has 'SONY' and 'PS4' branding visible in both photos.
Both photos carry a watermark for 'THE GAME GUY VENTURES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a camo controller, while photo 1 shows a black controller; it is unclear which is included.
No photo of the system storage or library screen is provided.
FIFA 27 and PES 27 are non-existent titles as of the current date.

risks.risk: Console may have the 'Blue Light of Death' or other power failures.
risks.proof: A video of the console booting to the main menu and launching a game.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing a disc being inserted, recognized, and played.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the UI or a controller test app.

risks.risk: Pre-installed games may be tied to a seller's account that will be removed.
risks.proof: A video showing the games are playable on a new user profile without the seller's account being primary.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and showing the system information screen.
Photo of the game library showing the installed titles.
Clarification on which controller is included and a photo of its back label.
Video of a disc being read by the console.
response.reason: The seller claims the console includes 'FIFA 27' and 'PES 27', which are impossible titles that do not exist. Furthermore, the photos show two different controllers while the text specifies only one, suggesting the images may not represent the actual item for sale.
